title: Paño brain (kit format)
description: The brain a site writes to put Paño on it with the kit: his name, any lines it changes, and its tours. It builds on base.json ("extends": "base"), which has neutral wording for every line, so every line here is optional apart from his name. Tour steps use only what the engine reads by itself (css), so a site needs no code of its own for them. Phill's own brains (latest/brain/) use more than this format allows. See kit/BRAIN.md.

extends.description: "base" for the neutral lines shipped with the engine. Or the address of another brain file (relative to this one) that itself extends base.

site.description: A short name for the site. Optional.

lines.description: What he says, grouped by where he says it. Write only the lines you want to change; the rest come from base.json. A line is a string, or a list of strings to pick from at random. Only <b> and <span> tags.

name.description: His name. Shown at the top of his bubble, and used wherever a line says {cat_name}.

labels.description: What screen readers say for his button and the bubble's close button.

^_.description: A note for people. Paño ignores any key that starts with _.

hello.description: His first words on a visit.

menu.description: His menu: what he asks, the buttons that are always there, and his goodbye.

^_.description: A note for people. Paño ignores any key that starts with _.

tour.description: Words around every tour. In "step", {n} and {total} are the step numbers and {name} is the tour's name.

^_.description: A note for people. Paño ignores any key that starts with _.

touch.description: Word swaps for touch screens ("Click" becomes "Tap"), applied to tour lines.

^_.description: A note for people. Paño ignores any key that starts with _.

background.description: Change the background and the colorblind modes (only where the adapter has "background").

options.description: His words for each of the page's backgrounds, keyed by the names in the adapter's background.walls.

^_.description: A note for people. Paño ignores any key that starts with _.

modes.description: His words for each colorblind mode: protan, deutan, tritan, mono.

^_.description: A note for people. Paño ignores any key that starts with _.

note.description: An extra line after a colorblind mode is applied. Leave it empty to skip it.

^_.description: A note for people. Paño ignores any key that starts with _.

cleanup.description: Window tidying (only on sites with a window system).

^_.description: A note for people. Paño ignores any key that starts with _.

bin.description: The Recycle Bin (only on sites with a window system).

^_.description: A note for people. Paño ignores any key that starts with _.
A note for people. Paño ignores any key that starts with _.

tours.description: His guided tours, by id. Each becomes a button in his menu.

^_.description: A note for people. Paño ignores any key that starts with _.

show.description: Which tours his menu offers, in order. Leave it out to offer every tour in the order written.

show_later.description: Tours that are written but not offered yet.

^_.description: A note for people. Paño ignores any key that starts with _.
A note for people. Paño ignores any key that starts with _.

label.description: The button for this tour in his menu, e.g. "How do I book a class?"

name.description: A short name, used where tour.step says {name}. Optional.

pages.description: The pages this tour is offered on, for a site with several pages that all load the same brain. Each is a page address relative to the brain file, as "extends" is: with the brain at pano/brain.json, a page beside index.html is "../contact.html" and the home page is "../" or "../index.html". "/" and "/index.html" are the same page, ".html" may be left off, and the query and hash are ignored. Leave it out to offer the tour on every page.

^_.description: A note for people. Paño ignores any key that starts with _.

step.description: One stop on a tour: he walks to the target, rings it and says "say". The visitor moves on with the "next" button, or by doing what "done" describes.

say.description: What he says. Only <b> tags. "Click" becomes "Tap" on touch screens.

css.description: A CSS selector for one element on the page. Prefer an id: "#contact-form".

when_visible.description: Only point once this element is showing.

done.description: What counts as the visitor doing it: this element becomes visible.

act.description: What the "Do it for me" button does: click, focus or submit one element.

actLabel.description: The act button's words, in place of "Do it for me".

next.description: A button that moves on, e.g. "Next" or "Got it".

skip.description: A second button that moves on.

need.description: Next waits until this box has something typed in it.

need_say.description: What he says if Next is pressed before the box is filled.

^_.description: A note for people. Paño ignores any key that starts with _.
